title: Priest with Schoolgirls on Playground, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1950s black and white snapshot capturing a Catholic priest interacting with two teenage girls on a school courtyard or church playground. One girl wears a structured plaid dress with a white collar, while the other wears a cozy cardigan sweater over a light dress. In the background, a basketball hoop, chain-link fence, palm trees, and other students are visible under bright sunlight. The back of the photo features the handwritten name 'Patricia Pearce' in cursive script.
